name: Cloudberry Coquette Pink Loveseat
prompt: Make an original editable Blender sofa, a broad TWO-PERSON PINK COUCH with continuous upholstered seat, thick softly rounded side arms, a wide high back, close-fitting cushions with NO gaps between components. Pastel bubblegum pink / blush pink furry velour plush upholstery with matte surface and rounded scallop edges; cute romantic kawaii coquette design. Four very conspicuous LARGE 3D heart-shaped throw pillows across the couch back, alternating red, white, red, white. Each heart has two rounded upper lobes and a point at the bottom, clearly red/white rather than generic rectangles. Couch is much wider than tall, with two seating positions, fully cohesive no floating parts, dark neutral scene, three-quarter view showing both arms and cushions. Real Blender meshes, save editable .blend and preview. Absolutely not a chair, stone stage, drone, or generic vehicle.
